title: Decision record
description: One row per judged attempt: work that was handed out, came back, and was judged against a standard written before the work started. Vocabulary version 0.1.0. See PROFILES.md for which fields are required at which conformance level.

task_id.description: The task this attempt belongs to. A task may be attempted more than once.

attempt.description: Which attempt at that task this row is.

task_type.description: What kind of work this was, from a list the domain writes.

decided_by.description: Who or what made the call. Pseudonymous identifiers are expected; report on kinds of work, never on named people.

standard_set_at.description: When the standard this was judged against was written. Must not be later than decided_at: the measure is defined before the observation.

reason_code.description: LOCAL. One value from a short list the domain itself writes, in its own language. Not conformed.

reason_class.description: CONFORMED. The shared class the local reason_code maps to.

reason_text.description: Optional free text. Required by convention when reason_class is 'other'.

data_class.description: How sensitive the material was, from the organisation's own classification scheme.

proposed_outcome.description: What software proposed, where a person then decided. Present with worker_kind 'person_with_agent' makes an override computable.

model_id.description: Which model answered, where routing selects one. A choice made by software on your behalf.

decide_seconds.description: Elapsed time to reach the judgement.

basis_refs.description: The records that were actually in front of whoever decided. Keys, not copies. A directed, typed, acyclic edge list: a decision can only cite what already existed.

allOf.description: An 'other' class carries free text, or the rate cannot be investigated.
A proposed outcome only means something where software proposed and a person then decided. Recording one against any other worker_kind makes the override rate wrong.

x-rules-not-expressible-here: standard_set_at must not be later than decided_at. JSON Schema cannot compare two fields, so spec/check-spec.pl and spec/check-profile.pl enforce it instead.
basis_refs must stay acyclic. A decision can only cite what already existed, which makes cycles impossible in correct data and detectable in incorrect data.

type.description: What kind of thing was cited: policy, claim, report, decision, dataset, model.

id.description: A stable identifier for it. Version it if it is versionable.
